_about: Hand-written recommender for indiefindr. Every number and phrase here was typed by the author from knowledge of games; nothing was fitted, searched or regressed. score.py only does arithmetic on it.

progression.d: stats, loot, levelling, numbers going up

creative.d: sandbox, self-expression, building for its own sake

mundane.d: everyday jobs, domestic, slice of life

anime.d: Japanese pop style, VN and JRPG conventions

steam_tag_axes._about: Sparse Steam user tag x vibe axis matrix, written by hand. Tags not listed (Indie, Singleplayer, 2D, Controller ...) carry no tone and load on nothing; they still count in the raw tag cosine.

steam_tag_conflicts: Steam tag pairs whose tones or formats do not belong in one slate. Feature = seed tags x this matrix x candidate tags (symmetric, negative). Attracting pairs (Roguelike~Roguelite ...) were written too and removed: exact tag overlap plus the axes already cover them.
